title: デビュー戦の後に・まだ見ぬ景色へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka returns victorious from her debut race, with the scenery from the lead burned into her memory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But it's not enough for her—she yearns to see even more breathtaking scenery in other races.
